With the consent of parties, the matter is finally heard at motion stage.

2. This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 12.07.2016 passed by 1st Additional MACT, Jabalpur in MACC No.186/2013 seeking Abhinay Rai vs Sheikh Sarif on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125041465/
1 enhancement setting aide award passed by Tribunal and to award appropriate compensation.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant, after relying on Vimla Devi and Others Vs. National Insurance Company Limited and Another (2019) 2 SCC 186, Dropdi Vs. Deepak and another 2016(3) JLJ 304,
Sunita Vs. Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation AIR 2019 SCC 994, Ravi Vs. Badrinarayan and Others (2011) 4 SCC 693, Janabai & Others Vol III (2022) ACC 571 (SC) and Smt. Champa bai V. Gopilal Meena MPWN (2002) (II) and referring to para-7 to 13 of impugned award, submits that after accident, appellant remained admitted for almost three months in Hospital.

sentences.text: Therefore, it was not possible for him to lodge report immediately.
It is also urged that Metro Hospital, where he was initially admitted, had informed police about the accident.
It is not necessary for appellant/claimant to examine owner and driver of offending vehicle.
No evidence has been adduced by respondent- Insurance company in rebuttal.
Only non filing of certain documents does not disprove the case of appellant.
On above grounds, it is urged that Tribunal has wrongly dismissed appellant's claim on the ground that it is not proved that offending vehicle was involved in the accident.

4. Learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance Company submits that as per evidence on record,
appellant's parents took appellant to the Hospital and appellant did not get unconscious, after the accident but still, no one has lodged the report about the accident, mentioning registration number of offending vehicle.
Seizure of offending vehicle has been effected after almost two months.
Complete documents along with the charge-sheet have not been filed by the appellant.
On account of factual differences pronouncement, relied on by the appellant do not apply to the facts of the case.
Hence, appeal filed by the appellant be dismissed.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

6. Sole issue involved in the case is whether from evidence on record, it is established that present accident has been caused by driver of Jeep bearing Registration No.MP.40D/0160.
7.
Perusal of deposition of appellant Abhinay Rai clearly reveals that at the time of accident, he saw number of jeep that hit him from behind and number of Jeep was MP40D/0160.
Thus, evidently, as per deposition of appellant Abhinay Rai himself he was going on motorcycle and was sitting on motorcycle as pillion rider and he was hit from behind.

In this situation, it is highly unnatural and improbable to have witnessed the number of offending vehicle, especially when there is no evidence on record to show that after accident, offending vehicle stopped at the scene of incident for any time whatsoever.
Appellant witness Abhinay Rai has also not deposed that after accident, vehicle stopped at the scene of incident and therefore, he witnessed the number of vehicle.
Appellant witness Abhinay Rai has admitted that he was conscious, after the accident.

8. It is evident from record of the case that appellant Abhinay Rai had been taken to Hospital by his parents and appellant witness Abhinay Rai has admitted that neither he nor his parent nor his friend, who was riding the motorcycle, informed the police about the accident.
9.
In the instant case, it is evident from record of the case that no report has been lodged by appellant or his parent.

Appellant has not furnished any explanation as to why his parents did not Abhinay Rai vs Sheikh Sarif on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125041465/
2 lodge the report about the accident mentioning therein number of offending vehicle.
10. From documents filed by the appellant, it is not clear as to when Police came to know about number etc. of vehicle that caused present accident.
From FIR also, it is not clear as to how Police came to know that accident has been caused by driver of Jeep bearing Registration No.MP40D-0160.
Appellant has not examined Investigating Officer etc.
Appellant has also not examined any person who informed police about the accident.

11. I have gone through the impugned award passed by the Tribunal, especially paras-7 to 13 and from above, it is apparent that Tribunal has discussed and assessed overall evidence on record in right perspective and has also discussed certain pronouncements relied upon by appellant.
12. In this Court's considered opinion, findings recorded by the Tribunal with respect to involvement of offending vehicle in the accident are proper and in consonance with evidence on record.

Therefore, Vimla Devi (Supra), Dropdi (Supra), Sunita (Supra), Ravi (Supra) Janabai (Supra) Smt. Champa bai (Supra) relied upon by appellant, do not help appellant in the facts and circumstances of the case.
13. In view of discussion in the foregoing paras, no interference is required for in the findings recorded by the Tribunal.
14. Hence, appeal filed by the appellant is dismissed.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE vai Abhinay Rai vs Sheikh Sarif on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125041465/
